research_question: In adults with advanced (locally advanced or metastatic) pancreatic cancer, what is the effect of fluoropyrimidine-based combination chemotherapy regimens (e.g. nab-paclitaxel or gemcitabine combined with S-1, capecitabine, or 5-FU/leucovorin) compared with gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel on overall survival?
treatment_label: Fluoropyrimidine-based combination chemotherapy regimen (e.g. nab-paclitaxel or gemcitabine plus S-1, capecitabine, or 5-FU/leucovorin)
outcome_description: Overall survival (time from randomisation/treatment start to death from any cause), extracted as the paper's own Cox proportional hazards / time-to-event estimate — log[HR] with its standard error, or the reported RR/HR with 95% confidence interval. Progression-free survival, objective response rate, disease control rate, and grade 3/4 toxicity outcomes are not the target outcome.
positive_direction: A positive Hedges g (i.e. an RR below 1 on the raw scale, re-signed so positive favors treatment) means the fluoropyrimidine-based combination regimen produced better overall survival (lower risk of death, longer survival) than gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel.
search_queries: nab-paclitaxel S-1 versus gemcitabine nab-paclitaxel advanced pancreatic cancer randomized trial overall survival
fluoropyrimidine capecitabine combination versus gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel metastatic pancreatic cancer clinical trial
gemcitabine nab-paclitaxel comparison 5-FU leucovorin regimen pancreatic adenocarcinoma survival hazard ratio
inclusion_criteria: Adults with advanced, locally advanced, or metastatic pancreatic cancer (any line of systemic therapy)
Compares a fluoropyrimidine-based combination regimen (S-1, capecitabine, or 5-FU/leucovorin combined with nab-paclitaxel and/or gemcitabine) against gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel
Reports a quantitative time-to-event estimate for overall survival (RR/HR with 95% CI, log[HR] with SE, or data from a Cox proportional hazards model)
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic review, meta-analysis, editorial, commentary, opinion piece, narrative review, or purely theoretical/modelling paper)

No comparison between a treatment and a control condition, or the comparator is not gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (e.g. best supportive care, gemcitabine alone, fluoropyrimidine alone), or the comparison is only between different doses/schedules of gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel

No quantitative overall-survival effect estimate from a Cox/time-to-event analysis that can produce an effect size (no log[HR] with SE and no RR/HR with 95% CI); outcome data limited to response rates or adverse-event counts
Completely unrelated to the research topic (not advanced pancreatic cancer, or not systemic fluoropyrimidine/gemcitabine-nab-paclitaxel chemotherapy)
moderators_to_extract: Study design (randomised controlled trial vs non-randomised/retrospective cohort)
Backbone of experimental regimen (nab-paclitaxel-based vs gemcitabine-based)
Line of therapy (first-line vs second-line or later)
Disease extent (locally advanced vs metastatic vs mixed)
Sample size category and geographic region (Asia vs Western)
effect_size_note: Extract the paper-reported Cox proportional hazards estimate for overall survival (log[HR] and SE, or RR/HR with 95% CI) directly; do not back-calculate or approximate hazard ratios from response-rate, disease-control, or adverse-event counts. If no Cox-model estimate for overall survival is reported, mark the study as not usable for this outcome.
